evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data quality, consistency and governance across multiple data sources.

evidence.domain_risk: Understanding of data governance, data quality and regulatory reporting requirements.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Financial services industry explicitly stated, and regulatory reporting requirements are named directly, so high domain risk.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Engineers; BI Analysts; senior leadership
evidence.data_team_maturity: Collaborate with Data Engineers to improve and optimise the organisation's modern data platform.

evidence.jd_authorship: Build and optimise ELT pipelines that transform data into clean, reliable datasets.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some responsibilities name specific technical activity (ELT pipelines, data models) but the framing throughout is generic recruiter language ('I'm currently working with...', 'strengthen its data and analytics function') typical of an agency-authored listing, so recruiter.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: improving data quality and enabling self-service analytics across multiple business functions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building trusted data models and self-serve analytics for internal consumers (Data Engineers, BI Analysts, business stakeholders broadly), placing it in internal_data.
evidence.autonomy_level: Support the development of dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are largely support/delivery-oriented ('support', 'develop and maintain', 'work with stakeholders to gather requirements') rather than direction-setting, so execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools or AI-consuming infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Familiarity with CI/CD and modern software engineering practices.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing/CI/CD appears only as a desirable skill/tool item, not as an owned responsibility with an ownership verb, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Understanding of data governance, data quality and regulatory reporting requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: data quality and regulatory reporting are named but only in the desirable-skills section, secondary to the delivery-focused responsibilities list.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: investing heavily in its data platform... Build and optimise ELT pipelines
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes signals of platform investment/growth with optimising existing ELT pipelines and an existing modern data platform, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybrid working (2-3 days per week in the Manchester office).

responsibilities: Develop and maintain scalable data models to support business intelligence and analytics.
Build and optimise ELT pipelines that transform data into clean, reliable datasets.
Work with stakeholders across the business to gather reporting and analytics requirements.
Ensure data quality, consistency and governance across multiple data sources.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to improve and optimise the organisation's modern data platform.
Support the development of dashboards and reporting solutions used by senior leadership.
Improve the accessibility and usability of data for business users through well-structured data models.
Document data models, transformation logic and analytics processes.
Identify opportunities to improve existing reporting, automation and data workflows.
Promote best practices around analytics engineering, testing, documentation and data quality.
